# HR Insights ZA

> HR Insights ZA is a Black woman-owned strategic HR consulting firm based in Pretoria, Gauteng, South Africa. Founded by Ntshebo Vivian Mofokeng, we specialise in HR governance, recruitment, employee relations, organisational development, and labour law compliance for businesses across South Africa.

## What We Do

HR Insights ZA helps South African businesses reduce people-related risk and strengthen performance. We design compliant, structured HR and organisational systems that align people practices with business reality and South African labour legislation (BCEA, LRA, Employment Equity Act).

### Our Approach
Before implementing any HR or recruitment service, we conduct an HR Diagnostic & Risk Assessment. This structured review identifies misalignment and potential exposure to penalties or operational risk across policies, contracts, role clarity, IR exposure, and recruitment governance.

## Services

### HR Governance & Documentation
We develop and align HR documentation to ensure compliance, consistency, and fairness. This includes employment contracts, offer letters, addendums, HR policies aligned to BCEA, LRA, and Employment Equity legislation, and procedural guidelines for managers.
URL: https://hrinsightsza.co.za/services/hr-governance-documentation

### Performance Management Systems
We design performance systems aligned to actual job roles, organisational objectives, and legal requirements. This includes job descriptions, role-specific KPI frameworks, performance review templates, Performance Improvement Plans (PIPs), and poor performance policies.
URL: https://hrinsightsza.co.za/services/performance-management-systems

### Employee Relations & IR Support
We provide structured IR support to ensure fairness and compliance at every stage. This includes disciplinary documentation and hearing dockets, chairing of disciplinary hearings, advisory support to management, and alignment of IR-related policies. We help reduce CCMA exposure.
URL: https://hrinsightsza.co.za/services/employee-relations-ir-support

### Organisational Development (OD)
Our OD services ensure organisational structures, roles, and people practices support performance rather than create risk. This includes organisational structure reviews, role clarity and job architecture, alignment of roles, performance, and accountability, and support during restructuring, growth, or change.
URL: https://hrinsightsza.co.za/services/organisational-development

### Recruitment Governance & Compliance
We support organisations in building recruitment systems that are fair, structured, and legally defensible. This includes recruitment and selection policy development, job specifications, interview guides and scoring templates, reference check templates, and Employment Equity alignment.
URL: https://hrinsightsza.co.za/services/recruitment-governance-compliance

### Recruitment
At HR Insights, recruitment is treated as a governance and decision-making process, not a transactional activity. We offer both retainer recruitment support for ongoing hiring needs and project-based recruitment for specific or once-off hiring needs.
URL: https://hrinsightsza.co.za/services/recruitment

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: How does HR Insights ensure my organisation remains compliant with labor laws?
A: We treat compliance as the foundation of your business. Our approach involves aligning all your HR documentation, from contracts to policies, with the BCEA, LRA, and Employment Equity Act. We conduct thorough compliance audits and identify gaps before they become costly disputes.

Q: What recruitment support models do you offer?
A: We provide flexible support tailored to your needs, including Retainer support for ongoing hiring and Project-based hiring for specific growth spurts. All our recruitment is governance-led to ensure fair and defensible processes aligned to Employment Equity requirements.

Q: Can HR Insights help reduce our risk at the CCMA?
A: Yes. By implementing procedurally fair disciplinary documentation, structured IR support, and job-aligned performance systems including Performance Improvement Plans (PIPs), we significantly reduce your organisation's CCMA exposure and vulnerability to disputes.

Q: How do you handle Organisational Development (OD)?
A: Our OD approach is diagnostic. We identify root causes through structure reviews and role clarity assessments to ensure your people practices support sustainable performance, rather than treating symptoms reactively.

Q: Why should we choose HR Insights over a traditional HR agency?
A: Traditional agencies often focus on just filling seats. HR Insights focuses on building defensible systems. We combine recruitment with governance, ensuring every hire and people decision is aligned to both South African labor law and your strategic business goals.

Q: What industries does HR Insights serve?
A: We serve businesses across all industries in South Africa, including SMEs, corporates, and startups. Our structured approach adapts to any sector that needs compliant, strategic HR systems.

Q: Where is HR Insights located?
A: HR Insights is based in Pretoria, Gauteng, South Africa. We serve clients across the country.

## Differentiators

1. Diagnostic-first approach: We assess risk exposure and compliance gaps before recommending solutions
2. Legally defensible systems: All our designs are grounded in BCEA, LRA, and Employment Equity legislation
3. Governance-led recruitment: We treat hiring as a decision-making process, not a transactional activity
4. Black woman-owned: Proudly contributing to transformation in South Africa's business landscape
5. LinkedIn-born authority: Founded from a community of millions of professionals who trust our HR expertise

## South African Labour Legislation Expertise

HR Insights ZA provides services aligned to the following South African legislation:
- Basic Conditions of Employment Act (BCEA)
- Labour Relations Act (LRA)
- Employment Equity Act (EEA)
- Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA)
- Skills Development Act
- Occupational Health and Safety Act
